normalised_vector_fields: generated element ids, renumbered in first-appearance order

rationale: A file digest on a rendered panel cannot separate a moved panel from a container that moved with it. The PNG bytes are reproducible here, but the SVG container is not: every render advances the <dc:date> element, rewrites the Matplotlib version token, and renames the generated clip-path ids. A content digest normalises exactly those three fields, so it fires when the drawn panels move and stays quiet when only the container is rewritten.
